newsitem.title: USA: HFS Inc says Becker to head National Realty.
newsitem.headline: HFS Inc says Becker to head National Realty.

text.p: HFS Inc said on Monday that Robert Becker, previously the president and chief executive of the company's Coldwell Banker Real Estate Corp unit, will become the president and chief executive officer of National Realty Trust.
In addition, HFS said in a statement, Becker will be succeeded at Coldwell Banker by Alex Perriello, formerly senior vice president of broker services for the subsidiary.

National Realty Trust, which owns more than 370 real estate offices in the United States, was established last year to acquire and operate residential real estate offices as franchised brokerages of Coldwell Banker and two other HFS subsidiaries, the company said.
HFS Inc is a global provider of real estate and travel services.
